summary_1line: Bhishma explains that although meat is nourishing, compassion and abstention from harming creatures bring far greater moral merit and spiritual reward.

image_candidates.scene_text: Royal sages hunt a deer in a wild forest, both hunter and animal poised in equal danger beneath towering trees.
A radiant compassionate man lies wounded on the ground while snakes and wild animals gather around him peacefully without harming him.
Souls suffer in the hell of Kumbhipaka, boiling in a great cauldron as a consequence of cruelty toward living creatures.
